# What should you charge for this dent repair or hail job?

> Free paintless dent repair and hail quote calculator: enter dents by size, aluminum and body-line share, tech time and comeback rate, and check your per-dent matrix against cost. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
